gitCommit.subject: Test/a2 2 (#22)
gitCommit.body:
Test/a2 2 (#22)

* applied coding standards for test data per domain.. it needs to have it's own tenant and memberships
fixed existing tests

* refactor

* fixed for the 3 known bugs:
- SUP-1067
- refresh token revocation
- membership escalation (i.e. admin can create an owner)

* code fix for A2 rotate api

* added tests for rotate key api

* added 2 more scenarios in gw test for rotating secrets

* added 1 more error and happy path tests

* added 1 more TC for default grace period

* added tests for key create/rotate in audit log

* fixed tenant's used in GW tests

* added tests for usage (covers both old and new secrets)

* added safari and firefox to tests

* fixed CI to cover installation of other browsers

* Test/part b unit tests (#23)

* Add unit tests + coverage for Part B, wire into CI as a fast pre-check

Unit tests (Jest, mocked DbService, no Docker/DB needed) cover the four
areas named in the brief: permission resolution (rbac.ts), limit
calculation (plans.ts), usage aggregation (usage.service.ts), and
billing arithmetic (billing.service.ts's overage calculation).
Coverage thresholds are enforced globally (per-file glob thresholds hit
an environment-specific path bug on this machine, documented in
jest.config.js).

CI: unit-tests now runs as its own job before playwright, so a broken
calculation fails fast in seconds rather than after a 30-minute E2E
run. A third publish-dashboard job (needs: both, if: always()) folds
unit test results into the existing gh-pages dashboard rather than
leaving them buried in the Actions tab, and always publishes even if
unit-tests failed and playwright never ran.

Also fixes .spec.ts files leaking into the production dist/ build
(added the standard tsconfig.build.json NestJS uses to exclude them).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Rename playwright.yml to ci.yml

Now runs unit-tests, playwright, and publish-dashboard as separate
jobs, not just Playwright — the filename was no longer accurate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Revert workflow rename to playwright.yml on this branch

Keeping the path matching main's (still playwright.yml, pending the
A2_2 -> main merge) so workflow_dispatch can still target this branch
directly from the Actions UI - GitHub only allows dispatching a
workflow that exists at the same path on the default branch. The
rename to ci.yml can be redone cleanly once this branch actually
merges into main.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Render unit test results on the dashboard page itself

build-report-dashboard.js already computed unitTests per run and wrote
it into data.json and the Actions step summary, but renderHtml() (the
actual published index.html) never read that field - so unit test
results existed in the data but weren't visible on the page anyone
actually looks at. Adds two summary stat cards and two table columns
(pass/total, statements coverage %, full breakdown on hover).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Document how to run each test layer in README

Replaces the stale "no test suite in this repository" line with how
to run unit tests (Jest) and functional/E2E tests (Playwright), plus
the CI workflow and dashboard link, per the brief's submission
checklist.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* add submissions md and screenshots

* applied some minor changes

* minor changes to doc
